white.description: Pure white. The on- colour for every solid fill. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

1.description: Radix slate 1. Page background. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

3.description: Radix slate 3. Subdued surface. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

7.description: Radix slate 7. Divider weight. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

10.description: Radix slate 10. Control boundaries at 3.69:1, lighter than slate/11 without dropping below 3:1.

11.description: Radix slate 11. Low contrast text. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

12.description: Radix slate 12. High contrast text. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

10.description: Radix indigo 10. Deeper than the step 9 solid, which read too bright. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

12.description: Radix indigo 12. Ink navy. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

Radix jade 11. Not for direct use: reference a Semantic role.

surface-variant.description: Subdued background: table header rows, inset panels.

outline.description: Dividers and decorative separators only, at 1.53:1 against surface. WCAG 1.4.11 does not cover a decorative separator, but it does cover the boundary of a control, so a control boundary MUST use outline-strong.

outline-strong.description: Boundary of any control the user must be able to locate: input and select borders. 3.69:1 against surface and 3.33:1 against surface-variant.

on-primary.description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

primary-hover.description: Hover and active state of primary.

focus.description: Focus indicator, outer ring. 15.98:1 against surface, but only 2.72:1 against a primary fill, so the indicator MUST be two toned: an outer ring in focus with a 2px inner gap in on-focus. The white gap carries the contrast against a coloured control, 6.02:1 on primary. Never remove the focus indicator, only restyle it.

on-focus.description: Focus indicator, inner gap. Sits between the control and the outer focus ring so the indicator stays visible on a coloured fill.

danger.description: Errors, and a payee name that does not match.

on-danger.description: Text and icons on a danger fill.

success.description: Confirmed, and a payee name that matches.

on-success.description: Text and icons on a success fill.

warning.description: Needs a decision, such as a close payee name match.

on-warning.description: Text and icons on a warning fill.

xs.description: 4px. Gap between a label and its control. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

md.description: 16px. Default gap and padding. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

lg.description: 24px. Between form groups. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

xl.description: 40px. Between page sections. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

none.description: Square, deliberately. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

sm.description: 4px. Inputs, buttons, badges. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

md.description: 8px. Cards, dialogs, tables. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

caption.description: 14px. Hints and metadata. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

body.description: 16px. Body and labels. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.

heading-lg.description: 32px. Page title. Compiled to rem by scripts/build-tokens.
